title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 10474 rto (AKU HT 71375)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 71375

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 71375; AKU grapheme T0180 (AKU GR 614). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: T12 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 438.
